description: This Java class 'MessageCommandSignalMapper' extends 'AbstractMessageSignalMapper' and provides implementations for extracting subject, status code, and message headers from 'MessageCommand' objects within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter signals module.

classes.name: MessageCommandSignalMapper
classes.description: A final class that maps MessageCommand signals by extracting subject, status code, and message headers.

methods.name: extractSubject
methods.description: Extracts the subject from the MessageCommand's message.

methods.name: extractStatusCode
methods.description: Extracts the optional HTTP status code from the MessageCommand's message.

methods.name: extractMessageHeaders
methods.description: Extracts the message headers from the MessageCommand.
